Title: TOM: Card limits and hunting grounds

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
bopo <k93...@hobbes.kzoo.edu> wrote:
>1) Tournament Magic has the "four of a card" limit thing, and many of the
>people I know who play it use that rule in normal play; is the same limit
>(or one of another #) suggested for Jyhad? Are there Jyhad Tournament rules
>yet? (How does everyone else out there do this?)

No tournament rules have been released yet for Jyhad.

>2) Each of the Hunting Grounds has a clan symbol which means that you must
>control a vampire of that clan to bring it into play. That much my group
>agrees on, but there are a couple of people who think that it should also
>mean that only vampires of that clan gain gain blood because of it...

This is incorrect. Like all master cards with a clan symbol, you only need
a vampire of that clan in order to play it. Since the hunting grounds don't
restrict themselves to giving blood to a given clan, they can give blood
to any of your ready vampires.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.

Messages.Author: bopo
Messages.Body:
Tom, here's a couple of questions my group has brought up:

1) Tournament Magic has the "four of a card" limit thing, and many of the
people I know who play it use that rule in normal play; is the same limit
(or one of another #) suggested for Jyhad? Are there Jyhad Tournament rules
yet? (How does everyone else out there do this?)

2) Each of the Hunting Grounds has a clan symbol which means that you must

control a vampire of that clan to bring it into play. That much my group
agrees on, but there are a couple of people who think that it should also

mean that only vampires of that clan gain gain blood because of it (even
though the text says nothing of the sort, yes.) I believe this to be wrong.
Is it?

Messages.Author: Daniel Hoffman
Messages.Body:
>Tom, here's a couple of questions my group has brought up:

>1) Tournament Magic has the "four of a card" limit thing, and many of the
>people I know who play it use that rule in normal play; is the same limit
>(or one of another #) suggested for Jyhad? Are there Jyhad Tournament rules
>yet? (How does everyone else out there do this?)

I don't feel this limit is really necessary for casual play unless one guy
has decided to be a jerk and put in 10 fame and 10 day operations with a ton
of bleed modifiers. I personally play with very few duplicates in my deck
because I use a lot of unique cards. If someone decides the way they want
to play is with 30 Wake with Evenings Freshness, I would let them because
with that many duplicates they would be easy prey for me and all their
vampires would end up in torpor from blocking so much. You can make up any
house rule you feel improves the game provided that everyone agrees.

>2) Each of the Hunting Grounds has a clan symbol which means that you
must>control a vampire of that clan to bring it into play. That much my
group>agrees on, but there are a couple of people who think that it should
also>mean that only vampires of that clan gain gain blood because of it (even
>though the text says nothing of the sort, yes.) I believe this to be wrong.
>Is it?

You would be correct. The text says nothing of the sort and the hunting
grounds may be use on any of your vampires just not the same vampire twice
in one turn.
